main_text.p: humores impenfius accendit. Quæ præte-rea de auri uiribus aduerfus peftis uirus fcribuntur,carbonariorum commenta pla-nè uidentur,quæ priore refponfione ad Io-fephi Quercetani carboniuori ineptias a-perte deteximus. Itaq; alexyteriorum,quæ frigida funt & ficca, internus,externusque ulus in hoc ueneni genere duntaxat pro-batur. Huius autem generis eft bolus Ar-mena,non autem illa rubrica,quę Pharma-copolis bolus orientalis nücupatur: quam peftilentia correptis non admodum pro-fuiffe Lugduni fatis percepimus, fed quæ colore eft pallido.Nam quæ uera eft bolus Armena (ueluti nobis tradit Galen. libro, de Simplicium medicamentorum faculta-tibus,nono)colore eft pallido,promptifsi-meq; foluitur in læuorem omnino æqua-le,ut calx,ualidamq; deficcandi uim pofsi-det:ubi mox addit contra peftilentes affe-ctus eam maximè conferre . Ætius & Pau-lus Ægineta,qui fuo tempore præ cæteris in arte medendi floruêre, idem cófirmant. Ille Tetra.primo,Sermone fecundo, de VeCap.2.[?] ra bolo nobis hoc fcriptum reliquit. Data nobis eft(inquit)in hac magna pefte etiam alia quędam terra ex Armenia, Capadocię

page.notes: The marginal note "Cap.2." at the right is hard to read; the numeral may differ. The word "ulus" is printed that way and is kept as printed. Printing errors kept as they are: "pallido.Nam" with no space, "tibus,nono)colore" with no space after the bracket, and the spacing of "conferre ." Greek: none on this page. The "Tetra.primo" reference is kept as printed.
